ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a dominant high-intensity white central region (>85% of visible surface) contrasted by low-intensity black margins along the trailing edges and localized dark spotting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary macro-blob of white pixels occupies the central and medial regions of both lobes. High-contrast black banding is mapped continuously along the trailing edges. Localized black mottling is visible at the lower-central region near the waterline and sporadically across the lower right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (jagged serrations) mapped along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, with significant peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward trajectory; the left lobe follows a linear-to-convex curve towards the distal tip, while the right lobe exhibits a more pronounced convex outer curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/cream pixel groups (barnacle shells) densely localized along the distal tip of the left lobe and the entire outer margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical dark linear disruption is detected near the lower-central base of the fluke; additional shorter diagonal dark streaks are present on the lower-left and lower-right quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive ectoparasitic colonization by barnacles along the outer margins. The upper-right trailing edge shows a significant irregular indentation/tissue loss relative to a smooth expected curve.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe's outer edge is characterized by a dense, continuous high-relief fringe of barnacle clusters that significantly alters the perceived 2D perimeter compared to the left lobe.
